role: post-freeze detection diagnostic; not a new V5 theorem family
setup: latent interaction persists across both periods and false-positive detection is absent

direction.q_current_gt_q_previous: observed gain is more probable than observed loss despite no latent state change
direction.q_current_eq_q_previous: observed gain and loss are equally probable
direction.q_current_lt_q_previous: observed loss is more probable than observed gain despite no latent state change

villavicencio_audit.score: q_current - q_previous using transition-specific fitted p_previous,p_current and each dyad's focal-plant census counts
villavicencio_audit.endpoint: among observed binary changed dyads, ROC AUC ranking gain over loss
villavicencio_audit.interpretation: mechanistic observation-process diagnostic only; the score is not an independent ecological predictor

claim_ceiling: The identity proves that unequal period-level detectability can create directional observed gain/loss from a persistent latent link. It does not estimate how many Villavicencio changes are biological, does not establish the binomial detection model as true, and does not validate ecological rewiring or routeability.
